product_wide_rationale: Corrects the record governing the single route by which any session acquires an implementation surface, so it binds every Domain rather than owning a runtime Domain.
summary: Amends CD-0098 D3 at its turn-end clause. The OpenCode move-session route offers no turn, busy, idle, queue, or lock handling, so the retarget takes effect from the next turn because a running turn resolves its paths before the move lands, not because the route waits for a boundary. The behavior is recorded as an observation of host 1.18.26 rather than a guarantee the host provides, and Concord adds no wait or poll of its own. Every other CD-0098 clause is preserved.
title: The move route offers no turn boundary, and the record says so
